verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA serves an llms.txt at developer.nvidia.com, and several developer-portal pages for the H200's software stack (HPC SDK, cuML, cuDF, Brev, AI models) are available as .md files an agent can read. Coverage is uneven, though: the CUDA Toolkit .md page returns 404, and no H200-specific product docs are shown in agent-readable form. Missing for 10: agent-oriented docs covering the H200 product page and specs, a working Markdown version of the CUDA Toolkit docs, evidence of what the llms.txt indexes beyond its header, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
